## [1.3.0](https://github.com/DrBushyTop/relay-morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* Night theme like OLED that turns dark grey in dim light ([2452e6a](https://github.com/DrBushyTop/relay-morphe-patches/commit/2452e6a405b875318dbaeef7897d66b674815a2a))

patches.name: Night theme like OLED, grey in dim light
patches.description: Makes the Night theme look like Night (OLED), except at very low brightness, where its blacks turn dark grey. For vivo phones with an adaptive refresh rate: they hold a mostly black screen at 60 Hz in dim light, which uses more battery than the grey. Night (OLED) is not changed.

patches.name: Open Reddit images in the image viewer
patches.description: Opens i.redd.it and preview.redd.it images (.jpeg, .webp, ...) in Relay's image viewer. Relay only recognised .jpg and .png, so these went to the browser, which Reddit now redirects to the comment thread. Also plays Reddit's MP4 copies of GIFs in Relay's video player.

patches.name: Prefer high refresh rate
patches.description: Asks for the display's highest refresh rate while Relay is scrolling or animating, so scrolling is not held at 60 Hz on adaptive refresh rate phones. The request is dropped once the screen is still, so static content can run at a lower rate.

patches.name: Show comment images inline
patches.description: Draws pictures and GIFs linked in a comment (Reddit uploads, Giphy, i.imgur) inside the comment instead of as a link. Tapping one opens it full screen as before. GIFs animate on Wi-Fi and show a still on mobile data. Follows Relay's NSFW Thumbnails setting. Can be turned off, or limited to Wi-Fi, in Settings > Behaviour > Comments.
